tasks.requirement: A cache invalidation crosses parser and service modules.
tasks.realistic_failure: A write returns a stale cached value after an update.

tasks.requirement: A boundary conversion preserves currency units across modules.
tasks.realistic_failure: A cents value is exposed as whole currency.

tasks.requirement: Legacy and current payloads retain their documented default.
tasks.realistic_failure: A legacy payload loses its compatibility default.

tasks.requirement: A versioned boundary maps an old field to its current meaning.
tasks.realistic_failure: A renamed field is silently ignored by the current consumer.

tasks.requirement: A failed batch does not leave partial persistent state.
tasks.realistic_failure: A partial write remains visible after a later operation fails.

tasks.requirement: A retry executes only operations that were not accepted.
tasks.realistic_failure: A retry repeats an already accepted external operation.

tasks.requirement: Replaying the same event preserves one logical effect.
tasks.realistic_failure: A repeated event is charged twice.

tasks.requirement: Resume starts after the persisted watermark.
tasks.realistic_failure: Resume processes the previously committed item again.

tasks.requirement: Cancellation is reflected in the aggregate state.
tasks.realistic_failure: A cancellation leaves an obsolete positive total.

tasks.requirement: Duplicate delivery does not inflate an aggregate.
tasks.realistic_failure: A duplicate event is counted twice.

tasks.requirement: A deterministic barrier preserves both concurrent increments.
tasks.realistic_failure: Two writers read the same value and one increment is lost.

tasks.requirement: Concurrent order does not change the canonical result.
tasks.realistic_failure: Arrival order chooses a non-canonical winner.
